headline: Authors report higher ARC-AGI-3 solve rates from test-time agent communication in a bounded setup
summary: A September 17 preprint compares shared-workspace teams with independent parallel agents on 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. Using Claude Sonnet 4.6, the authors report full-game solve rates of 4.6% for teams of three and 8.0% for teams of five, versus 1.4% and 2.2% for the best of three and five independent attempts. Matching the reported team solve rates required 13 and 33 independent attempts, respectively. The paper also reports gains on two research-oriented tasks, but says communication can lose under limited compute or unclear feedback. These are author-reported results from one model and benchmark setup; the research desk did not reproduce them.
